title: Completed EARNED VALUE ANALYSIS REPORT Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed EARNED VALUE ANALYSIS REPORT artifact data payloads (PMO-06.05).

budget_at_completion_bac.description: The total approved baseline budget allocated for the complete project scope.

planned_value_pv_current_reporting_perio.description: The authorized budget assigned to scheduled work for the current reporting period.

planned_value_pv_current_period_cumulati.description: The cumulative authorized budget planned from project start through current period.

planned_value_pv_past_period_cumulative.description: The cumulative planned value calculated at the close of the previous reporting period.

earned_value_ev_current_reporting_period.description: The budgeted amount for the work actually completed during the current period.

earned_value_ev_current_period_cumulativ.description: The cumulative budgeted amount for all work accomplished from project start to date.

earned_value_ev_past_period_cumulative.description: The cumulative earned value achieved as of the previous reporting period.

actual_cost_ac_current_reporting_period.description: The actual expenditures incurred for work performed during the current period.

actual_cost_ac_current_period_cumulative.description: The cumulative total actual costs incurred from project start through current period.

actual_cost_ac_past_period_cumulative.description: The cumulative actual costs recorded as of the previous reporting period.

schedule_variance_sv_current_reporting_p.description: The schedule performance in financial terms (EV - PV) for the current period.

schedule_variance_sv_current_period_cumu.description: The cumulative schedule variance (Cumulative EV - Cumulative PV) to date.

schedule_variance_sv_past_period_cumulat.description: The cumulative schedule variance as of the prior reporting period.

cost_variance_cv_current_reporting_perio.description: The financial budget variance (EV - AC) for the current reporting period.

cost_variance_cv_current_period_cumulati.description: The cumulative cost variance (Cumulative EV - Cumulative AC) to date.

cost_variance_cv_past_period_cumulative.description: The cumulative cost variance as of the prior reporting period.

schedule_performance_index_spi_current_r.description: The schedule efficiency ratio (EV / PV) for the current period.

schedule_performance_index_spi_current_p.description: The cumulative schedule efficiency ratio (Cumulative EV / Cumulative PV).

schedule_performance_index_spi_past_peri.description: The cumulative schedule efficiency index from the previous reporting period.

cost_performance_index_cpi_current_repor.description: The cost efficiency ratio (EV / AC) for the current period.

cost_performance_index_cpi_current_perio.description: The cumulative cost efficiency ratio (Cumulative EV / Cumulative AC).

cost_performance_index_cpi_past_period_c.description: The cumulative cost efficiency index from the previous reporting period.

percent_planned_current_reporting_period.description: Planned Value divided by BAC for the current reporting period.

percent_planned_current_period_cumulativ.description: Cumulative Planned Value divided by BAC to measure scheduled completion percentage.

percent_planned_past_period_cumulative.description: Cumulative Planned Value divided by BAC as of the prior reporting period.

percent_earned_current_reporting_period.description: Earned Value divided by BAC for the current reporting period.

percent_earned_current_period_cumulative.description: Cumulative Earned Value divided by BAC representing actual project percent complete.

percent_earned_past_period_cumulative.description: Cumulative Earned Value divided by BAC as of the prior reporting period.

percent_spent_current_reporting_period.description: Actual Cost divided by BAC for the current reporting period.

percent_spent_current_period_cumulative.description: Cumulative Actual Cost divided by BAC representing total project budget spent to date.

percent_spent_past_period_cumulative.description: Cumulative Actual Cost divided by BAC as of the prior reporting period.

eac_w_cpi_current_reporting_period.description: Estimate at Completion assuming future work performed at current period CPI (BAC / CPI).

eac_w_cpi_current_period_cumulative.description: Estimate at Completion assuming future work performed at cumulative CPI.

eac_w_cpi_past_period_cumulative.description: Estimate at Completion based on past period cumulative CPI.

eac_w_cpi_spi_current_reporting_period.description: Estimate at Completion factoring both cost and schedule indices for current period.

eac_w_cpi_spi_current_period_cumulative.description: Estimate at Completion factoring cumulative cost and schedule performance indices.

eac_w_cpi_spi_past_period_cumulative.description: Estimate at Completion factoring past period cumulative cost and schedule indices.

to_complete_performance_index_tcpi_curre.description: Cost efficiency required to complete the remaining work within BAC for current period.
Cost efficiency required to complete the remaining work within BAC cumulatively.

to_complete_performance_index_tcpi_past_.description: TCPI calculated at the close of the prior reporting period.

selected_eac_justification_and_explanati.description: Detailed justification of the selected EAC forecasting formula and expected final budget outcome.

root_cause_of_schedule_variance.description: Underlying drivers and operational causes for schedule efficiency or delay.

schedule_impact_incl_implications_of_con.description: Projected delivery delays and critical path impacts if schedule trends continue.

root_cause_of_cost_variance.description: Operational factors, rate fluctuations, or scope drivers causing cost variances.

budget_impact_incl_intended_actions_rese.description: Financial exposure and reserve utilization strategies to maintain fiscal control.

comments.description: Additional contextual observations or recommendations from the EVM analyst.
